overall_notes: This paper is primarily about data augmentation for NLU (Natural Language Understanding) tasks, not NLG evaluation. While it generates synthetic text using language models, the main focus is on improving NLU model performance through data augmentation, not evaluating NLG systems or studying NLG tasks themselves. The automatic metrics (Novel Mention, Self-BLEU) are used to evaluate the diversity of generated synthetic data for augmentation purposes, not to evaluate NLG system outputs.
